identitySignals: Name matches the City of Oakland's Oakland Workforce Development Board (oaklandca.gov), located in Oakland, CA, matching the agenda location

Board oversees city-wide employment and training programs under the federal Workforce Innovation and Opportunity Act, matching an MOU with OUSD's Adult and Career Education department on partnerships and data sharing
Search results indicate OUSD Adult Education is a mandated partner in the local America's Job Center of California (AJCC) MOU administered by the board
research.notes: The agenda vendor is a multi-party MOU (City of Oakland via the Oakland Workforce Development Board plus unnamed AJCC partner agencies), not a single organization. This profile covers only the City of Oakland's Oakland Workforce Development Board, so confidence is medium and it should not be published as the profile of the whole group.

profile.summary: The Oakland Workforce Development Board is a board of the City of Oakland set up under the federal Workforce Innovation and Opportunity Act. It oversees city-wide employment and training programs that connect residents with career opportunities and help businesses find skilled workers.
